subject: Discovery recap — MediCore inference SLOs & MPA proposal
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@medicore.ai>, Priya Singh <priya.singh@medicore.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 03 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery recap — MediCore inference SLOs & MPA proposal

Alex / Priya — thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our end and a proposed mutual action plan (attached) to keep momentum. Please skim and flag anything missing.

Top pain points we heard
- High tail latency for interactive triaging (~95th percentile spikes to 700–900ms on current infra)
- Unpredictable token cost growth when model usage scales (3x in peak weeks)
- Compliance requirement: all inference logs must be retained for 90 days and exportable for audit

Goals you mentioned
- 95th percentile latency <= 300ms for 2k concurrent sessions within Q3 pilot
- Pilot cost target: average per-1k-token unit cost under $3 equivalent
- Internal sign-off: Security (Priya), Platform (Alex), Procurement (TBD)

Proposed mutual action plan (draft attached) — highlights
1) Pilot kickoff & integration (April 25–May 9) — onboarding SE + SDK integration, sample traffic tests
2) Performance tuning & quantization profile (May 10–May 24) — dedicated bench runs + batching config
3) Security review & SOC2 evidence exchange (May 25–June 4) — provide audit logs, KMS integration notes
4) Exec review & procurement (June 7–June 18) — decision meeting; target signed reserve by June 30

Owners we propose
- Redwood AE: Stephanie Nguyen (me) — overall program owner
- Redwood SE: Ben Carter — integration + perf tuning lead
- Customer Security: Priya Singh — compliance gate
- Customer Platform: Alex Turner — integration & acceptance

Next asks (please reply inline)
- Confirm the stakeholders above and add procurement contact
- Are the milestone dates above realistic for your team?
- I'll send a short instrumentation checklist for initial traffic sampling by Monday.

Attachments: MPA-draft-v1.pdf, SLA-summary.xlsx

Thanks — looking forward to aligning timelines.

—
Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123

From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@medicore.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya.singh@medicore.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 03 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Discovery recap — MediCore inference SLOs & MPA proposal

Thanks Stephanie — useful summary. A couple quick clarifications and one ask: 

1) Decision process: Priya (Security) signs off on evidence, Alex (Platform) signs off on integration results, final commercial approval comes from Procurement (Maria Lopez) and our Head of Data (Ethan Park). I'll loop Maria once we land the dates.
2) Latency goal: 95th <=300ms is aggressive but achievable if we can validate quantized model paths + prefix caching. We need 2 weeks of sustained sample traffic to be confident.
3) Compliance: 90-day retention is correct; we also need a sight-line into log export format (JSON schema). Priya — can you confirm this aligns?

Dates look fine from my side; suggest we shift the performance tuning window one week earlier (May 3–May 17) to leave more buffer before the security review.

I reviewed the attached MPA-draft-v1.pdf and added inline comments. Happy to run perf tests with Ben next week.

—
Alex Turner
Platform Engineering Manager | MediCore
alex.turner@medicore.ai | +1 650-555-4492
